test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion logically follow(s) from statements.

**Statements:**

All horses are donkeys.

All monkeys are donkeys.

**Conclusions:**

i. Some horses are monkeys

ii. Some monkeys are horses.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7fe26db18188ee2d81223890372f4288165eae36617f6e30e8f5449397b6d434.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some horses are monkeys → Does not follow (As all horses are donkeys and all monkeys are donkeys. So it is possible but not definite.)

II. Some monkeys are horses → Does not follow (As all horses are donkeys and all monkeys are donkeys. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Neither conclusions I nor II follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"
